faqs.question: Can you build around our private knowledge?
faqs.answer: We first review access rules, data sensitivity and retrieval needs. Private material is integrated only under an agreed access and hosting approach.

faqs.question: How do you assess output quality?
faqs.answer: We agree representative examples and acceptance criteria, test failure cases and define where human review remains necessary.

faqs.question: Can you improve an existing website?
faqs.answer: Yes. We inspect its framework and working features first, then agree changes that preserve useful content and existing URLs.

faqs.question: Will we be able to update content?
faqs.answer: We can use your existing CMS or agree an appropriate editing workflow as part of the scope.

faqs.question: Do you support both iOS and Android?
faqs.answer: We review the required platform capabilities and audience before recommending a cross-platform or platform-specific implementation.

faqs.question: Is app-store approval guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. Store review is controlled by Apple and Google. We can support preparation and respond to review feedback within the agreed scope.

title: AI Automation
headline: Give repetitive work a traceable automation workflow.
description: Connect business rules, tools and AI-assisted tasks with clear review points and exception handling.
detail: Connect business rules, tools and AI-assisted tasks with clear review points and exception handling.
problems: Repeated data handling slows delivery
Exceptions disappear between disconnected tools
Teams need oversight of AI-assisted decisions

process.title: Step 4
process.description: Monitor failures and hand over controls

faqs.question: Which tasks should stay with a person?
faqs.answer: Judgment-heavy or sensitive decisions should have defined review points. We map these before introducing automation.

faqs.question: What happens when a connected tool fails?
faqs.answer: The workflow can include retries, failure alerts and a manual recovery path suited to the tools involved.

title: AI Integration
headline: Bring useful AI into the software you already use.
description: Add AI capabilities to existing applications without losing sight of permissions, reliability and the current user experience.
detail: Add AI capabilities to existing applications without losing sight of permissions, reliability and the current user experience.
problems: An existing product needs an intelligent feature
AI pilots sit outside the main workflow
Data access and reliability are unclear

process.title: Step 1
process.description: Audit the current interface and data access

faqs.question: Do we need to replace our current software?
faqs.answer: Usually the first step is to inspect supported APIs and extension points. Replacement is considered only if the existing constraints require it.

faqs.question: Can providers be changed later?
faqs.answer: Provider abstraction and portability can be included in the design when they are requirements of the agreed scope.

title: UI/UX Design
headline: Make complex products feel clear and considered.
description: Translate requirements into accessible user journeys, focused interfaces and a practical design handover.
detail: Translate requirements into accessible user journeys, focused interfaces and a practical design handover.
problems: People cannot find the next step
Screens have inconsistent patterns
A new product lacks a tested interaction model

faqs.question: Can you use our existing brand?
faqs.answer: Yes. Existing brand assets, component conventions and accessibility requirements are reviewed before design work begins.

faqs.question: Do you also implement the designs?
faqs.answer: Implementation can be combined with web or mobile development, or handed over to your existing engineering team.

title: Software Testing & QA
headline: Find release risks before your users do.
description: Test critical workflows, document reproducible failures and help your team make informed release decisions.
detail: Test critical workflows, document reproducible failures and help your team make informed release decisions.
problems: Regressions recur after releases
Critical user journeys lack repeatable checks
Bug reports are difficult for developers to reproduce

process.title: Step 4
process.description: Retest fixes and summarize release risks

faqs.question: Does testing guarantee a bug-free product?
faqs.answer: No. Testing reduces uncertainty within agreed coverage; the report explains what was tested and what remains outside that scope.

faqs.question: Can you work with our developers?
faqs.answer: Yes. Defects can be logged in your existing tracking system with reproduction steps, evidence and retest status.

title: Deployment & Maintenance

description: Prepare environments, coordinate releases and support the operational work needed after launch.
detail: Prepare environments, coordinate releases and support the operational work needed after launch.

faqs.question: Are hosting costs included?
faqs.answer: Hosting and third-party subscriptions are identified separately unless explicitly included in the engagement.

faqs.question: Do you provide continuous support?
faqs.answer: Coverage, response expectations and maintenance responsibilities are agreed for the selected support arrangement.

title: B2B Lead Generation

audience: Service businesses entering a new market

process.title: Step 4

faqs.question: Do you guarantee leads will become clients?
faqs.answer: No. Research identifies potential fit. Sales outcomes depend on the offer, timing, outreach quality and the prospect’s needs.

faqs.question: How do you handle prospect information?
faqs.answer: We agree appropriate sources, access rules, data minimization and retention before research. Sensitive personal data is not part of a standard prospect list.

faqs.question: Who handles replies?
faqs.answer: Reply ownership, tone and escalation are defined during setup. Interested prospects can be handed to your sales team or appointment-setting workflow.

faqs.question: Can you guarantee inbox placement?
faqs.answer: No. Delivery depends on mailbox configuration, reputation, recipient systems and campaign behavior. We review readiness and avoid promised deliverability rates.

faqs.question: How are opt-outs handled?
faqs.answer: The agreed workflow must record opt-outs and suppress further outreach. Audience suitability and applicable communication requirements are reviewed before sending.

faqs.question: Will you replace our logo?
faqs.answer: Only if logo work is explicitly requested and scoped. Existing identity can be retained while improving messaging and creative consistency.
